subject: Prioritization refresh request — recap + next step options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + suggested next steps

Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and a couple clear next-step options so you can pick what makes sense for your team: 

Key signals from the call:
- Primary use case: low-latency semantic search for customer support KBs (short queries, 8–32 tokens typical).
- Expected traffic: bursty peaks during product launches (~150 rps) but baseline ~10 rps.
- Data sensitivity: PII-extracted logs, need VPC/self-host or strict ingestion controls.
- Main success metric: 90th pctl latency < 150ms for interactive lookups, with cost objective ~40% below current infra spend.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) Technical deep dive (30–45m): include your infra lead + our infra eng to validate VPC/networking and latency targets. I can bring our solutions architect.
2) Pilot proposal (4–6 weeks): scope a small prod pilot on Dedicated pools, include performance baseline + cost estimates.
3) Put on hold — check-in in 6–8 weeks if timing shifts.

Attached: discovery MAP (high-level milestones / responsibilities) and a quick MVP cost estimate for the pilot so you have ballpark economics.

Would you prefer option 1 or 2? If neither, say "hold" and I'll set a reminder to re-touch.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood-discovery-MAP.pdf (PDF summary), mvp-cost-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Jordan — bumping this in case it got buried. Short version: we can run a focused technical deep dive this week or put the pilot scoping on ice and re-open later. No pressure — just trying to align on next steps so we don’t waste your team’s calendar.

If helpful: I pulled a 30-minute slot for Wednesday afternoon (linked in HubSpot). Happy to move if another time works.

Cheers,
Aditya
